data.text: [00:00]CD1 Track 6
M = Man, W = Woman
[00:03.8]So, let’s see … what time do you get up … you know, on a work day?
[00:11]Well, um … I suppose I usually get up at about six o’clock during the week.
[00:18]Six o’clock!!
[00:19.1]Yes … it’s usually about six o’clock.
[00:23]Are you serious?! Why do you get up so early?
[00:26]Um … I often go running in the mornings before work … for about half an hour in the park.
[00:34.3]Do you?!
[00:35]Well, yes … I mean, I like starting the day with some exercise.
[00:41.6]Really? I don’t!
[00:44.3]I find it wakes me up … What about you? How often do you do exercise or sport during the week?
[00:53]Oh, probably about four or five times a week …
[00:58.2]Really? Me too. What kind of exercise do you do?
[01:03]Well … I don’t really like going to the gym. It’s really boring.
[01:09]Yes, that’s the same as me!
[01:11]So, I usually go for a swim after work – you know, Monday to Thursday … I don’t usually go on Fridays.
[01:20]What do you do on Fridays then? Do you go out?
[01:24]Yes, of course. It’s the end of the week … I always go out with friends.
[01:29.6]Yes, definitely … It’s the start of the weekend.
